observations: Two large circular eye forms dominate the upper half, each containing a green iris with a red X-cross mark at center, ringed by dense black spiral lines.
The head tapers to two pointed ear-like peaks at the top corners, outlined in white against a flat burnt-orange background that fills the entire field.
A rectangular open mouth at the bottom shows vertical black lines across white; loose yellow scribble lines trail down the left edge and across the lower face.
reading: The two X-marked eyes pull attention first — green fields crossed in red, wound tight with black spirals that read as pressure or alarm. The barred mouth below adds a sense of something held open rather than speaking. Blue, pink, and purple lines layer across the face without settling into smooth form, keeping the surface restless. The flat orange ground pushes the whole figure forward.
